_what: The Studio's edit stage (edit_stage.py): after a production's versions are rendered and before its covers, the swipe's edit moves (frame map edits and camera moves, sound sheet effects and music changes) are set on our clock; the stage lays the sound effects into the music bed's own rows itself, checks the music drops against the bed, and holds the covers until every other move (punch-in, flash, graphic pop) is laid or has a reason in brief.json "edit". The Checks panel shows every move (Edit moves).
_lay_sfx: true: each swipe effect with no effect of ours within sfx_window seconds is laid into music/bed.json effects from the sound bank. false: effects are only checked.
_hold: true: a move neither laid nor reasoned holds the production before the covers. false: the stage reports and the covers go on.
_props_from_tool: true: a graphic pop counts as laid only when its record names image-production pictures (a file with a run.json beside it). false: any record counts.
_rollback: "on": false turns the stage off: render goes straight to the covers as before. One part: set it false (lay_sfx, hold, props_from_tool). One machine only: VIDEO_STUDIO_EDIT_OFF=1 (all), or a comma list of parts. Row EDIT-STAGE in team/rollbacks.md.
_music_from_swipe: true: a production whose music/bed.json is not made from the swipe gets its bed made from the swipe's sound sheet (genre, tempo, key, instruments, drops and hits), its sections on our cuts (ElevenLabs Music). false: the bed is only checked.
_line_check: true: every spoken shot of the rendered cut is read against the words under it (the vision_judge door); a miss holds and names the shot and the line. false: not read.
_props_template: true: brief.json "layers" are laid through layers.py (centred, waist height, never in a close-up, image-production cut-outs) and checked. false: the layers are left as they are.
_brief_notes: true: every edit note in the brief (5-brief.md B-ROLL, CARDS, END CARD, LAYERS AND SOUND; brief.json edit_notes) is a row, checked where the stage can read it, else laid or reasoned in brief.json edit. false: the notes are not read.
_listen: true: a swipe whose sound sheet has no ear-checked music or no human sounds is listened to again (video-teardown listen.py): its isolated music read twice, its people's non-word sounds measured. false: the sound sheet is used as it is.
_reactions: true: every non-word sound the swipe's people make (sound-sheet human_sounds) is made in the production's reaction voice (brief.json edit_voices.reactions, eleven_v3 audio tags) and laid as its own effect row at its second. false: they are not made.
_director: 2026-11-17 (owner: one move for now, machine decision making): true: the moves director (edit_moves.py) pitches safe / bold / wild per scene from video-edit's moves library and keeps ONE by its stated rule (beat, the brief's creative-controls target, what the edit lays free); the pick is written to edit/moves-picks.json and laid by to_studio.py on the next render. A move needing paid generation or a drawer the edit lacks is a gap row, never made. false: no picks, nothing laid.
_director_pitch: claude: the director prompt (moves/prompts/creative-director-v2-owner.md) through the chain's Claude door, the rules pitch when the door is not reachable. rules: the shortlist pitches, no model.
_hold_why: 16 Nov, owner: the swipe gives the idea and the scene order; the edit is ours. Its moves are suggestions the stage reports, never a hold. The hard rows (line_check, a silent bed, props_template, brief_notes) hold whatever this switch says (V57).
_music_from_swipe_why: 17 Nov, owner: music comes from our own chain (song.py --suno-bed, the avatar's lane, made in Suno), never remade from the swipe's sound sheet.
